title: The Bridegroom Soon Will Call Us
description: The Bridegroom Soon Will Call Us in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Johann Walther, first published in 1552. The English translation is by Matthias Loy (1880). The tune, ACT GOTT VOM HIMMELREICHE, is by Michael Praetorius (1609). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: The Bride-groom soon will call__ us, Come, all ye wed-ding guests! May not His voice ap-pall__ us, While slum-ber binds our breasts; May all our lamps be burn__-ing, And oil be found in store, That we, with Him re-turn__-ing, May o-pen find the door.

lines: The Bridegroom soon will call us,
May not His voice appall us,
May all our lamps be burning,
And oil be found in store,
They will not blush to own us
Love ever will be shown us
We all shall come before Him,
As Lord and God adore Him,
Will give us crowns of gold
And deck us with His graces
All saints shall sing His praise,
And bring with joy before Him
